query FlxChatbotSettingsScreen($days: Int = 30) {
  flxSettings {
    chatbot {
      ...FlxChatbotSettingsFields
    }
  }
  flxChatbotAdmin {
    stats(days: $days) {
      total
      human
      resolved
      leads
      orders
      rating
      rated
      open
    }
    status {
      key
      state
      title
      text
      url
      urlLabel
    }
    textDefaults {
      key
      text
    }
    pageTypes {
      key
      label
    }
    weekdays {
      key
      label
    }
    avatarUrl
    notifyEmailDefault
    aiReady
    aiSettingsUrl
    fluxChatReady
    fluxChatActive
    shopActive
    ordersActive
    wikiActive
    inboxUrl
    siteUrl
    preview {
      config
      scriptUrl
    }
  }
}

mutation FlxChatbotSettingsSave($input: FlxChatbotSettingsSaveInput!) {
  flxChatbotSettingsSave(input: $input) {
    settings {
      ...FlxChatbotSettingsFields
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}
